meta.title: 글자판 termpan
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (글자판 (termpan), a terminal dashboard (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A Tokyo Night-like terminal: background #14151F, text #C0CAF5, dim #565F89 for prompts and comments, and five accents by role: cyan #7DCFFF, blue #7AA2F7, magenta #BB9AF7, green #9ECE6A (prompt, memory, success), yellow #E0AF68 (the message), red #F7768E (shading).
rationale.type: Nanum Gothic Coding Bold at 40 px only, on a 20 x 44 grid where Latin takes one cell and Hangul two; big letters are made of characters chosen by coverage, never of a bigger font.
rationale.motion: Terminal motion: typing at a typist's pace with a block cursor, characters flying in from anywhere to land on their cells (scrambling until they land), the donut spinning, sparklines scrolling, process lists ticking, boxes drawing in one after another.
rationale.sound: Chiptune at 128 BPM in G major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s), pulse arps, triangle bass, noise drums; keystrokes for typing, blips for landings, a confirm on install.
rationale.visuals: All code: a cell buffer rendered with one font, box outlines and block bars drawn to the grid (the font has no half-width box glyphs), text rasterised into cells by coverage, the donut from donut.c computed into the grid, live sparklines.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the terminal speaks in text.
